scope: Synthetic voxel software planning and Runner fixture; no new Gazebo/ROS2/hardware/LLM campaign.

method.episodeMeans: All episodes, including partial/failure, have equal weight. pathLengthM sums succeeded geometry legs; do not divide by legs or retain only completed episodes.
method.pairedDifference: variant minus baseline within the exact same sceneId/seed and frozen input; relativeDelta is null when baseline is zero.
method.cluster: occupancyGeometryHash; average paired condition deltas inside each geometry, then give each geometry equal weight.

bootstrap.sampling: Geometry clusters with replacement, preserving all paired fault conditions and all metrics/arms together.
bootstrap.interval: Descriptive 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles, linearly interpolated at (replicates-1)*q.

method.communication: meanObservationJSONBytes is the arithmetic mean of episode.messageBytes over all episodes; the historical field name is retained for compatibility and is not limited to raw observations. Count all actual recorded communication channels, including observation_upload, occupancy_relay, coverage_delta (coverage IDs), coverage_reconnect_snapshot (coverage IDs), reconnect_snapshot (occupancy), and the legacy combined observation_upload_and_relay channel when present. Delayed maps count only when sent; unsent queued packets are not transmitted bytes. These are canonical JSON payload bytes, excluding network framing, TLS, task leases, controller traffic and other unmeasured transport overhead.
method.inputCommunicationDescription: Canonical observation payload upload plus relay and reconnect snapshot; excludes network framing, TLS and lease/control messages.
limitations: No multiple-comparison adjustment or significance decision.
Intervals describe this fixed study's empirical layouts; no universal optimality or population generalization claim.
Planning wall time depends on host load; this is not physical robot or network validation.
Configured seeds/paired task conditions are not necessarily independent physical maps; cluster normalization prevents duplicate geometry from increasing its weight.

pythonMain.reason: Research paragraphs pushed make home-furnished outside the first 2500 README characters; paragraphs moved below the quick-start example, guard retained.

docsBook.countingNote: Documentation and focused checks overlap the main collection; do not add to main total.

validation.countingNote: Keep the full Python command exit 1; 15 README and 128 focused checks overlap the main collection and are not added to a synthetic total. Two new scope rejection cases were collected only by subsequent focused checks.

metricNotes.coverage: Fixed preregistered ROI observed voxel classification fraction, not surface reconstruction; means include all partial episodes.
metricNotes.pathLengthM: Succeeded geometric legs only; physical travel and uncertain executed distance unmeasured.
metricNotes.messageBytes: Actual recorded canonical JSON channels including explicit coverage IDs; excludes networking, TLS, leases, controller traffic and unsent queued maps.
metricNotes.time: Exploration planning wall milliseconds on this host; Runner timestamps are virtual, not elapsed performance.
metricNotes.bootstrap: Geometry-equal paired deltas, 5000 cluster resamples, descriptive percentiles only; no multiplicity adjustment or significance test.
